jonny-desktop.task: meristem: add non-humanoid archetypes (golem/construct) so granite_golem, lattice_sentinel and the crystallized enemies stop being men in grey, then remap and rebake
jonny-desktop.note: DONE + PUSHED. meristem @ 3735424 on main; vanguard @ da02b86 on regions/side-areas. Added a GOLEM archetype so built things stop being grey humanoids. The bestiary reference sheet labels each creature's archetype and 19 of 43 were humanoid, including granite_golem, lattice_sentinel and crystallized_mage - a golem drawn as a man in grey is a silhouette failure and section 4.1 asks a character to be recognisable from its outline alone; no shading pass fixes that because the SHAPE is the problem. golem.py has three builds (stone, crystal, lattice) and every choice in it exists to move the silhouette away from humanoid: shoulders near the full canvas width where a humanoid's are half, NO NECK (head is a block seated straight on the mass), arms as hanging slabs, stumpy legs so weight sits low, and a lit core instead of a face. MEASURED 46-51 percent silhouette IoU against a humanoid of the same palette, versus the 90 percent the vanguard audit flags as confusable. Humanoid count 19/43 -> 16. 98 tests pass, 1100 resources load. TWO ITERATIONS, BOTH CAUGHT BY LOOKING NOT BY THE NUMBER: crystal first shared stone's outline exactly - the original problem restated one level down - and now chamfers its shoulders to taper upward; lattice first carved horizontal gaps the full width and read as a slatted BENCH, and is now a narrow column with one break and two orbiting shards. Also note my own regex insertion put an import inside a multi-line import block and broke the module - repaired; string surgery into multi-line constructs keeps costing me. STILL HUMANOID ON PURPOSE: ashguard ranks, Rhogar, Vasek, Haric, Sevrin, the Mirror, Yara - those are people. CANDIDATES FOR A LATER PASS: crystallized_stillkeeper, living_crystal, frost_construct - drawn by a different tool (vanguard_new_enemies.py) and not in vanguard_bestiary.py, so they were out of scope here.

Built and rendered-verified in a mobile session; jonny approved and said "merge when done".

STEPS:
1. Add the dashboard as xylem/docs/dashboard.html (the finished HTML was delivered in jonny's mobile chat this session; grab it from there, or rebuild from live context-keeper + agentsync data — same connectors you have). No secrets in it.
2. If GitHub Pages isn't serving yet (root https://jarmstrong158.github.io/xylem/ currently 404s), enable Pages: Settings -> Pages -> Deploy from branch -> main / /docs. The landing page docs/index.html should come live at the same time.
3. Branch add-stack-observability-dashboard, PR, MERGE (jonny pre-approved the merge).
4. Verify live at https://jarmstrong158.github.io/xylem/dashboard.html and reply here with the confirmed URL.

NOTE: mobile could not push/PR from claude.ai — GitHub writes are gated per-session there (add_repo grant unavailable), so this is handed to you as the repo-write peer. Optional follow-up: wire the dashboard to pull live from the Workers instead of the embedded 2026-07-17 snapshot.
